"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar (M1-T15: forward fill with a gap limit)."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from mdata import GapError, Prices, RawRow, align_calendar

FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "fixtures" / "mdata"


def _load(case: str) -> tuple[list[RawRow], int, dict]:
    case_dir = FIXTURES / case
    source = json.loads((case_dir / "input.json").read_text())
    expected = json.loads((case_dir / "expected.json").read_text())
    rows = [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in source["rows"]]
    return rows, source["max_gap"], expected


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps() -> None:
    rows, max_gap, expected = _load("TC-02")

    prices = align_calendar(rows, max_gap=max_gap)

    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
    assert tuple(prices.dates) == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert tuple(prices.tickers) == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(prices.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(prices.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_max_gap_fills_short_gaps() -> None:
    rows, _, expected = _load("TC-02")

    prices = align_calendar(rows)

    assert tuple(prices.dates) == tuple(expected["dates"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(prices.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker() -> None:
    rows, max_gap, expected = _load("TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == "GapError"

    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(rows, max_gap=max_gap)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_default_max_gap_also_rejects_six_date_gap() -> None:
    rows, _, expected = _load("TC-03")

    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(rows)
